# Bynor UI skill

Read `DESIGN.md` and `antislop.md` first. Build a work surface around the task social managers perform, not a generic chart-and-stat dashboard.

- Keep the client switcher global. Client analysis follows the selected profile; the appointments calendar includes all clients.
- Keep Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok selectable. Put channel, period, and custom date range near the data they control.
- A report action must let the user choose platforms, date range, and report sections before printing or exporting.
- Use the forest/paper/ink system and reserve leaf green for selection and primary actions. DM Sans is for dense UI; Playfair Display is for editorial headings.
- Vary composition only when hierarchy needs it. Prefer compact lists and useful chart context over decorative cards, generic icons, or filler sections.
- Keep the chart question and its range visible. Never make a statistic look like a verified account insight when it is sample data.
- Use motion only to clarify a transition or action. Follow reduced-motion preferences.

Before delivery, check the purpose of every prominent visual technique and confirm every control has a real behavior.
